# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Upcoming compatibility changes**

## Highlights

The next 4.155 release updates image decoding, GLES interop, and the bundled HarfBuzz engine. RAW and DNG decoding will no longer be available, while GLES interop moves to pointer-based signatures.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG image decoding is disabled** — Applications that decode RAW or DNG images through SkiaSharp must use an alternative decoder before upgrading. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — OpenGL ES interop callers should update native interop code to use the new pointer-based signatures. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine for the next release line. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))
